name: @aise/world-solution-substrate
description: AISE Solution-layer + desktop substrate contracts (WORLD-P0-C): substrate-neutral typed adapter contracts for the Layer-3 solution world — the scene-usage contract composing the P0-A reality ports (Babylon scene runtime with the ghost-distinctness law honored end-to-end, USD what-if variants with paths never canonical identity, glTF solution-asset delivery), the parametric CAD contract (FreeCAD the reference implementation; engine-neutral; document/object names are namespaced external labels, never AISE identity; exact-geometry predicates delegate to the P0-B exact-geometry port vocabulary with tolerance-DECLARED comparisons; glTF/IFC export through the sibling delivery/interpretation vocabularies), the execution-simulation contract (deterministic 4D typed transforms over the canonical Solution Graph + EngineeringOperation vocabulary — the substrate computes trajectories, the Solution Graph stays the only authority), and the desktop shell integration contract (shell lifecycle, typed sidecar spawn/query/teardown for the heavy substrates, window/view state — implementable by EITHER shell candidate). Every contract is proven implementable WITHOUT its substrate by in-memory substitution doubles; no substrate is imported; failures use the HFX-000 closed vocabulary; determinism throughout (no network, no clock reads, no randomness).
